input.quote: Sanofi may terminate this Agreement (A) in its entirety by providing [***] written notice of termination to RevMed or (B) on a country-by-country or Product-by-Product basis by providing [***] written notice of termination to RevMed
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no liquidated damages, penalty, or minimum/early-termination fee payable by us. Searches for "liquidated damages", "penalty", "termination fee" and "minimum" return nothing, and Sanofi's termination for convenience right (Section 12.2(a)(i)) is exercisable on notice alone — the effects of termination in Section 12.3(c) are limited to reversion of licenses, transition assistance and inventory transfer (with RevMed paying for inventory and post-termination royalties to us), not a compensatory payment by us. This meets the preferred position of no Customer-payable liquidated damages. Two adjacent items are noted but not deviations under this rule: Section 9.6 late-payment interest is mutual (payable by whichever Party pays late) and capped at the maximum rate permitted by Applicable Law, which is ordinary default interest rather than a penalty; and Section 15.6(f) bars the arbitrators from awarding punitive or exemplary damages, which operates in our favour. The upfront, milestone and royalty amounts in Article IX are negotiated consideration, not liquidated damages.
